children: Japanese stocks are lower in early trade following declines in U.S. technology shares overnight as concerns about higher energy costs persist. Semiconductor and bank stocks are leading the declines. Kioxia Holdings is down 9.2% and Mizuho Financial Group is 5.6% lower. The dollar is at 156.32 yen, down from Y157.19 as of Thursday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are closely watching crude oil prices and developments in Ukraine and the Middle East. The Nikkei Stock Average is down 2.2% at 61518.38. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
